Chat completion via Azure OpenAI with the azure/ prefix for provider routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	req := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model:       `azure/gpt-4`,
		Temperature: ptr(float64(0)),
		MaxTokens:   ptr(uint64(16)),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Chat(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].Message.Content)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].FinishReason)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Model)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Usage.TotalTokens)
}
```
